name: Button

sections.Purpose: Execute one clearly named action, such as saving an agent or creating a conversation. A primary button identifies the main action in a local task.
sections.Anatomy: Native button; text label; optional leading/trailing EASM icon; centered loading indicator over the preserved content layout. block controls layout width and selected exposes a toggle state.
sections.Variants: primary for the principal action; secondary for supporting actions; subtle for low emphasis; destructive for an explicitly destructive action. A variant is a semantic emphasis, not a destination or custom color.
sections.Sizes: sm: 32 px; md: 40 px (default); lg: 48 px. These are minimum heights, so translated or wrapped text may increase height. Coarse pointers receive a minimum 44 px target.
sections.States: Default, hover, pressed, keyboard focus, disabled, loading and selected. Native disabled removes activation and sequential focus. Loading keeps focus, sets aria-busy/aria-disabled and blocks click/Enter/Space; label and glyph layout remain in place with opacity zero, preserving the accessible name while the centered spinner is visible.
sections.Color behavior: Primary: #2F6BEB (primary-fill) → #2563EB hover → #1D4FD8 pressed, with white text. Secondary is a grey track fill (#F1F3F6 → #E8EBF0 hover → #DEE2E8 pressed) with #101318 text and no outline. Subtle is #2563EB text on transparent, #EEF4FF on hover. Destructive is #D92644 → #B81D38 with white text. Selected keeps a persistent fill; disabled uses neutral tokens and drops any outline.
sections.Icon behavior: UIIconName (the approved @easm-ui/icons registry); 16/20/24 px for sm/md/lg, 1.6 px standard stroke and currentColor. Icons supplement the label. Loading uses the shared branded spinner at 16/20/24px in an absolute centered overlay, preserving the existing content width; icons inherit the button foreground, including white on primary.
sections.Typography: 13/14/16 px for sm/md/lg; weight 600; line-height 20 px at sm/md and 24 px at lg. Label can wrap without truncating the action.
sections.Spacing: Horizontal padding 12/16/20 px for sm/md/lg; icon-to-label gap 8 px; adjacent actions separated by 8 px. block stretches within its layout, not the viewport.
sections.Borders & surfaces: 8 px radius. No variant draws an outline: buttons are told apart by fill (blue, grey track, transparent, red). A disabled button keeps its shape with a transparent border, and a disabled subtle button stays transparent. No gradients, shadows or signature-orange fill for routine actions.
sections.Motion & micro-interactions: Color, border and opacity transitions use 140 ms with cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1). Reduced motion removes transitions. Interaction and application work start immediately; animation never delays an operation. Loading rotation is functional; reduced motion retains a static busy indicator and the accessible busy state.
sections.Accessibility: Native button with type=button by default; set type=submit intentionally for form submission. Keep its visible label meaningful. selected maps to aria-pressed for a toggle action. Keyboard focus is one 2 px #2F6BEB edge with a soft 4 px halo (rgb(47 107 235 / 20%)): the focus-ring token. Fields show the halo around their own border (field-focus-ring); clipped rounded shells and menu rows use an inset 2 px edge. Forced colors keep a visible system outline.
sections.Responsive behavior: Allow the label to wrap; choose block for narrow forms. Avoid forcing equal widths across unrelated actions. sm/md target height expands to 44 px for coarse pointers.
sections.Content rules: Use a verb and object when needed: Save agent, Create ticket, Retry upload. Keep the same accessible label and target dimensions during loading; do not imply success before the application confirms it.
sections.Usage rules: Use a link for navigation. Keep one primary action per local task. selected is for reversible toggle actions; avoid combining it with destructive commands. Own asynchronous loading/success/error in application state; use ConfirmationDialog when destructive confirmation is required.

api: ButtonProps: native button attributes; variant=primary|secondary|subtle|destructive; size=sm|md|lg; leadingIcon/trailingIcon: UIIconName; loading, block, selected: boolean. Native ref forwards to HTMLButtonElement.
example: <Button variant="primary" size="md" leadingIcon="save" onClick={() => saveAgent()}>Save agent</Button>

name: IconButton

sections.Purpose: Perform a familiar compact action when its icon is sufficiently recognizable, such as closing a drawer or opening a menu.
sections.Anatomy: Button foundation, one centered icon, and a required label rendered for assistive technology. No visible text slot, leading/trailing icon pair, or block layout.
sections.Variants: primary, secondary, subtle (default), destructive. Pick emphasis using the action context; the icon shape and name do not change between hover and pressed states.
sections.Sizes: Square 32/40/48 px for sm/md/lg with glyph 16/20/24 px. sm/md expand to at least 44×44 px for coarse pointers.
sections.States: All Button states: hover, pressed, focus, disabled, loading and selected. loading preserves the target and its accessible action name while preventing repeated execution.
sections.Color behavior: Inherits Button colours. Primary and destructive glyphs are white on #2F6BEB and #D92644; secondary sits on the grey track (#F1F3F6) with a #101318 glyph; subtle uses a #2563EB glyph and an #EEF4FF hover fill. Disabled colours affect the glyph and target together.
sections.Icon behavior: Exactly one UIIconName. Use close for dismiss and the approved action icon for commands. more-horizontal is the approved @easm-ui/icons v 1.2 registry glyph, matching the 24-unit rounded geometry. Keep decoration out of the accessible name.
sections.Typography: No visible typography. The label is a complete localized action name, not a glyph ID or tooltip fragment.
sections.Spacing: Center glyph on both axes; no ad hoc offsets to compensate for an unrelated icon set. Keep at least 8 px between separate compact targets.
sections.Borders & surfaces: 8 px corner radius, no outline in any variant; the focus halo sits outside the target. Never crop the glyph or the focus ring within a tight parent.
sections.Motion & micro-interactions: Color, border and opacity transitions use 140 ms with cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1). Reduced motion removes transitions. Interaction and application work start immediately; animation never delays an operation. No hover spin, bounce or shape replacement.
sections.Accessibility: label is required and sets aria-label. Native Enter/Space activation and disabled behavior. A Tooltip may supplement the name, but never provide its only accessible name. Keyboard focus is one 2 px #2F6BEB edge with a soft 4 px halo (rgb(47 107 235 / 20%)): the focus-ring token. Fields show the halo around their own border (field-focus-ring); clipped rounded shells and menu rows use an inset 2 px edge. Forced colors keep a visible system outline.
sections.Responsive behavior: Use the coarse-pointer expansion; if the command is ambiguous, expose a Button label on narrow or unfamiliar workflows instead of relying on density.
sections.Content rules: Name the action: Close dialog, Remove attachment, More actions for Aisha. Include the object where multiple identical controls exist.
sections.Usage rules: Use only for compact, recognizable actions. Do not rely on icon-only destructive commands where users need consequences explained.

api: IconButtonProps: Button props except children, leadingIcon, trailingIcon and block; required icon: UIIconName and label: string; default variant=subtle.
example: <IconButton icon="close" label="Close details" onClick={() => closeDetails()} />

name: SplitButton

sections.Purpose: Expose a frequent default action beside related alternative commands without hiding that default action in a menu.
sections.Anatomy: Main text Button plus adjoining chevron IconButton, each with independent activation, wrapped as one visual group. DropdownMenu owns the alternative items.
sections.Variants: Same main-button emphasis variants as Button. Both segments share size and emphasis. The arrow is not a second primary business action.
sections.Sizes: sm: 32 px; md: 40 px (default); lg: 48 px. These are minimum heights, so translated or wrapped text may increase height. Coarse pointers receive a minimum 44 px target. The chevron segment is square at the matching control height.
sections.States: Main action supports Button states; arrow supports closed/open menu, hover/focus, disabled. Main disabled or loading also disables the menu trigger, preventing contradictory actions during processing.
sections.Color behavior: Both segments use the same Button fill, separated by a 2 px gap of the surface behind them rather than a line. A primary SplitButton opens a dark ink menu (#121826 with #FFFFFF text); other variants open a white menu over the page or a grey panel over cards.
sections.Icon behavior: Optional leadingIcon on the main action; fixed chevron-down on the menu segment. Menu items may have one EASM icon each. Avoid redundant trailing icons beside the chevron.
sections.Typography: Main label uses Button 13/14/16 px and weight 600; menu commands use readable 14 px. menuLabel names the alternatives for assistive technology.
sections.Spacing: No gap between segments. Main label padding follows Button; arrow remains an independently usable target. Leave 8 px around neighboring action groups.
sections.Borders & surfaces: 8 px radius on the two outer ends, square adjoining edges and no doubled outline between the parts. The menu spans the whole button and uses the overlay surface contract (fill, no shadow).
sections.Motion & micro-interactions: Color, border and opacity transitions use 140 ms with cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1). Reduced motion removes transitions. Interaction and application work start immediately; animation never delays an operation. Menu opens/closes with the 200 ms anchored-overlay transition; reduced motion removes it.
sections.Accessibility: Two native buttons; main label identifies the default action and menuLabel identifies the alternatives. Menu trigger exposes expanded/menu relationship; menu provides arrows, Home/End, typeahead, Escape and focus return. Keyboard focus is one 2 px #2F6BEB edge with a soft 4 px halo (rgb(47 107 235 / 20%)): the focus-ring token. Fields show the halo around their own border (field-focus-ring); clipped rounded shells and menu rows use an inset 2 px edge. Forced colors keep a visible system outline.
sections.Responsive behavior: Preserve two full targets; wrap the main label as needed. On constrained layouts prefer a named main Button and a separate overflow control rather than shrinking the arrow.
sections.Content rules: The default action must be obvious: Export CSV with Export XLSX as an alternative. Alternative items are related verbs and outcomes, not unrelated settings.
sections.Usage rules: Use when a stable default is much more common than its alternatives. Do not encode mutually exclusive persistent options as commands; use Select or SegmentedControl.

api: SplitButtonProps: Button props except trailingIcon; required items: MenuItem[]; menuLabel defaults More actions. onClick handles the main action; item.onSelect handles alternatives.
example: <SplitButton leadingIcon="download" menuLabel="Other export formats" onClick={() => exportCsv()} items={[{ id: "xlsx", label: "Export XLSX", onSelect: () => exportXlsx() }]}>Export CSV</SplitButton>

name: ButtonGroup

sections.Purpose: Visually and programmatically associate related independent actions, such as previous/next or a compact action toolbar.
sections.Anatomy: Named role=group wrapper containing Button or IconButton children; optional attached seams; horizontal or vertical orientation.
sections.Variants: attached=false keeps normal 8 px separation; attached=true joins related segments. orientation=horizontal or vertical. Each child retains its own Button variant.
sections.Sizes: No independent control size; children use matching sm 32/md 40/lg 48. Mixed child sizes create inconsistent target edges and are discouraged.
sections.States: Wrapper has no pressed, selected, loading or disabled state. Individual children own those states; one pending action need not disable unrelated actions.
sections.Color behavior: No group background or accent. Children keep their Button fills; a selected action stays visible without recolouring the wrapper.
sections.Icon behavior: Child icons follow the Button/IconButton contract. The wrapper adds no icon or decorative label. Attached seams stay 1 px, logical corners support RTL, and an only child retains all four outer corners.
sections.Typography: No visible wrapper label unless the surrounding layout renders one. Child labels keep Button typography; the required group label is an accessible summary.
sections.Spacing: Separate children by 8 px, or by 0 px only when attached. Horizontal loose groups can wrap; vertical groups stretch consistently.
sections.Borders & surfaces: No frame around the group. Attached groups keep only the outer 8 px corners and raise the focused child so its halo shows; children draw no outlines of their own.
sections.Motion & micro-interactions: Only children transition; do not animate reordering, attachment or width when a button becomes busy. Color, border and opacity transitions use 140 ms with cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1). Reduced motion removes transitions. Interaction and application work start immediately; animation never delays an operation.
sections.Accessibility: label names role=group. Tab reaches each native button; a group is not a toolbar/radiogroup and does not add roving arrow-key behavior. Keyboard focus is one 2 px #2F6BEB edge with a soft 4 px halo (rgb(47 107 235 / 20%)): the focus-ring token. Fields show the halo around their own border (field-focus-ring); clipped rounded shells and menu rows use an inset 2 px edge. Forced colors keep a visible system outline.
sections.Responsive behavior: Loose groups wrap in reading order; choose vertical for narrow forms. Attached horizontal sets must retain full target sizes and not force content off screen.
sections.Content rules: Group label describes a shared purpose, such as Record actions. Each child label must make sense independently.
sections.Usage rules: Use for independent commands. Use SegmentedControl for a mutually exclusive value and Tabs for changing panels.

api: ButtonGroupProps: div attributes; label:string required; attached?:boolean; orientation?:horizontal|vertical; children:ReactNode.
example: <ButtonGroup label="Record actions"><Button>Save</Button><Button variant="secondary">Cancel</Button></ButtonGroup>

name: TextField

sections.Purpose: Collect a single short textual or numeric value, such as a user name, institutional email or endpoint URL.
sections.Anatomy: Label and single native input; optional decorative leading/trailing icon slots. Validation copy is linked to the same input.
sections.Variants: type=text (default), email, password, tel, url or number. Password is a native masked value; there is no automatic reveal toggle in this version.
sections.Sizes: md 40 is the default; lg 48 for spacious forms; sm 32 is an explicit compact mode. Use minimum heights and coarse-pointer 44 px targets; do not assign arbitrary heights.
sections.States: Empty/filled, hover, focus, disabled, read-only, required, error and success. Disabled is noninteractive; read-only preserves reviewable content and prevents mutation.
sections.Color behavior: White field surface (#FFFFFF) with #101318 entered text and #69707E placeholder; #858D9B grey border (3:1 on white and on the #FFFFFF page), #6F7888 on hover, #2F6BEB with the focus halo. Error uses #D92644 with an explanatory message; success uses #0C8138 with a message. Disabled uses #F3F4F6 and #9AA1AD; read-only takes the page fill (#FFFFFF) and stays legible.
sections.Icon behavior: leadingIcon/trailingIcon are noninteractive EASM glyphs: 16/20/24 px for sm/md/lg. Give actionable trailing controls their own implementation instead of making a decorative glyph clickable.
sections.Typography: Inter/system; 14 px control text at md, 13 px at sm, 16 px at lg; label follows the same 13/14/16 px size scale at weight 600; explanatory and validation copy 13 px. Line-height 1.5; do not shrink text to fit.
sections.Spacing: Label/control and control/description gaps use 8 px; control/validation and description/validation gaps use 4 px. Horizontal control inset is 12 px; icon slots reserve space rather than overlap text. Adjacent fields use at least 16 px.
sections.Borders & surfaces: 1 px functional grey border (#858D9B) and 8 px control radius: inputs are the one place the theme keeps an outline, because a field boundary must meet 3:1. The parent field has no extra card. Error and success borders remain distinct from focus. Never use #E8EAEE (border-subtle) for a control boundary.
sections.Motion & micro-interactions: Color, border and opacity transitions use 140 ms with cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1). Reduced motion removes transitions. Interaction and application work start immediately; animation never delays an operation.
sections.Accessibility: A visible label is programmatically linked to the native control. description, error and success IDs join existing aria-describedby; error sets aria-invalid and aria-errormessage. Validation messages are linked descriptions, not automatic live announcements; the application owns validation summaries or focus on an invalid field. Use native required and an explicit form-level explanation of required fields. Keyboard focus is one 2 px #2F6BEB edge with a soft 4 px halo (rgb(47 107 235 / 20%)): the focus-ring token. Fields show the halo around their own border (field-focus-ring); clipped rounded shells and menu rows use an inset 2 px edge. Forced colors keep a visible system outline.
sections.Responsive behavior: Control width follows its form grid; allow labels/messages to wrap and collapse multi-column forms before controls become cramped. Coarse-pointer control height is at least 44 px.
sections.Content rules: Label the object (Institutional email). Match autocomplete/inputMode and constraints to the value. Do not use type=number for student IDs, telephone numbers or codes with leading zeros.
sections.Usage rules: Use TextArea for paragraphs, SearchField for querying, DateField/TimeField for temporal values. A number field still needs domain bounds and server validation.

Native id/disabled/readOnly/required/name/form and control ref are retained. type?:text|email|password|tel|url|number; leadingIcon/trailingIcon?:IconName; native input onChange.
example: <TextField label="Institutional email" type="email" name="email" autoComplete="email" required description="Use your university email address." />

name: PasswordField

sections.Purpose: Enter a secret credential when an account or sign-in workflow requires it. The user can deliberately reveal the entered text to check it.
sections.Anatomy: TextField foundation with native password input, visible label, linked description/validation, optional leading glyph and one named visibility action.
sections.Variants: Revealable by default; revealable=false keeps a permanently masked input. Native read-only and disabled states remain available. The component never assesses password strength.
sections.Sizes: Standard sm 32/md 40/lg 48 minimum input heights with 16/20/24px supporting artwork. Visibility action uses 32px target, expanding to 44px on coarse pointers.
sections.States: Masked/revealed, default, hover, keyboard focus, disabled, read-only, error and success. Disabled/non-revealable state remasks content; form reset also remasks it.
sections.Color behavior: Opaque white input, neutral text, functional border; blue focus and visibility action. Error/success use linked semantic text and borders. No signature-orange credential emphasis.
sections.Icon behavior: Shared eye and eye-off switch only in response to an explicit visibility change. Decorative leading artwork remains 16/20/24px. The button name describes Show password or Hide password.
sections.Typography: Input label 13/14/16px for sm/md/lg,600 weight; entered text same size, regular weight; supporting/error text 13px. Secret values are never substituted into the action label.
sections.Spacing: Uses TextField label/message gaps and input padding. One fixed trailing slot reserves 44px on fine pointers/56px coarse, with 4px inset; toggling never changes field width.
sections.Borders & surfaces: 8px input radius with a single rounded white/blue focus halo. Visibility target stays inside the field with its own clean rounded focus edge; validation does not alter control thickness.
sections.Motion & micro-interactions: 140ms action/focus color response; type and pressed state update immediately. No animation of the actual secret, delayed reveal or artificial busy state; reduced motion removes color transitions.
sections.Accessibility: Native password/text input keeps name, autocomplete, required and ref behavior. Visibility button has a connected aria-controls and pressed state; activation preserves value, selection and input focus. Keyboard focus is one 2 px #2F6BEB edge with a soft 4 px halo (rgb(47 107 235 / 20%)): the focus-ring token. Fields show the halo around their own border (field-focus-ring); clipped rounded shells and menu rows use an inset 2 px edge. Forced colors keep a visible system outline.
sections.Responsive behavior: Field stretches to its form column. Long labels/messages wrap, the fixed action slot remains visible and coarse pointers receive 44px targets. Never squeeze the secret below usable input width.
sections.Content rules: Use Password or Confirm password with explicit credential instructions. Supply current-password or new-password autocomplete intentionally. Do not show, log or announce the secret in supporting text.
sections.Usage rules: Use for actual credentials; use TextField for nonsecret identifiers. Server validation and password policy belong to the product. The visibility toggle changes only local presentation, never authentication state.

api: PasswordFieldProps: TextField props except type/trailingIcon/trailingControls; revealable=true; native HTMLInputElement ref; value/defaultValue/onChange, name, autocomplete, required and validation remain native.
example: <PasswordField label="Password" name="password" autoComplete="current-password" required />

name: NumberField

sections.Purpose: Enter a numeric quantity or configurable limit, with optional discrete increase/decrease controls and native numeric constraints.
sections.Anatomy: TextField foundation, native number input, label, linked supporting/validation text and two bounded step actions. The input remains the semantic spinbutton.
sections.Variants: steppers=true by default; steppers=false keeps keyboard/native numeric editing. step may be a positive number or any; any disables fixed-step buttons rather than inventing an increment.
sections.Sizes: Input follows sm 32/md 40/lg 48 minimums. Both independent step actions use 32px targets, expanded to 44px coarse. The component exposes no arbitrary field-height override.
sections.States: Empty/entered, default, hover, focus, disabled, read-only, error/success and min/max action availability. Empty editing reports null; invalid native text remains subject to browser validity.
sections.Color behavior: Opaque white input with neutral value; blue action glyphs and focus. Disabled/read-only use neutral surfaces. Minimum/maximum availability is communicated through button disabled state, not a color-only warning.
sections.Icon behavior: Shared subtract and add artwork at 16px in 32px action targets. The visible value stays aligned with ordinary fields; glyphs cannot shrink or become substituted local drawings.
sections.Typography: Numeric entry uses the regular 13/14/16px input scale. Label 600; descriptions/errors 13px. Values are not silently currency-formatted, rounded or replaced by localized unit strings.
sections.Spacing: Two fixed trailing slots reserve 80px on fine pointers/104px coarse; each target remains separate with 4px gap and 4px edge inset. Empty/disabled values retain identical geometry.
sections.Borders & surfaces: Standard 8px field frame and one rounded white/blue focus halo; both inner actions have clean control radii. Native duplicate browser spin artwork is hidden while keyboard numeric semantics remain.
sections.Motion & micro-interactions: 140ms button/color response with immediate native stepping. No rolling-digit animation or delayed commit; focus stays on the numeric input and reduced motion removes optional transitions.
sections.Accessibility: Native type=number retains required, min, max, step, form, name and validity. Named Decrease/Increase actions become unavailable at bounds. onValueChange reports number|null without fabricating native change events. Keyboard focus is one 2 px #2F6BEB edge with a soft 4 px halo (rgb(47 107 235 / 20%)): the focus-ring token. Fields show the halo around their own border (field-focus-ring); clipped rounded shells and menu rows use an inset 2 px edge. Forced colors keep a visible system outline.
sections.Responsive behavior: Use a reasonable form-column width; labels/validation wrap while the step targets stay whole. Set steppers=false for extremely narrow numeric cells and preserve accessible keyboard editing.
sections.Content rules: Name the unit in the label or persistent description, such as Daily capacity or Timeout in seconds. Supply finite bounds and a positive step; avoid placeholder-only labels and unexplained abbreviations.
sections.Usage rules: Use for quantities and limits. Use TextField for identifiers such as phone numbers, account numbers and codes. Money/large-precision decimals require an explicit product formatting/storage contract; this component uses native browser number semantics.

api: NumberFieldProps: TextField props excluding type/value/defaultValue/onChange/trailing slots/min/max/step/inputMode; value:number|null, defaultValue:number, min/max:number, step:number|any, onValueChange(number|null), steppers=true; native HTMLInputElement ref.

sections.Purpose: Capture a query for a list or search workflow while making querying and clearing recognizable.

Error uses #D92644 with an explanatory message; success uses #0C8138 with a message. Disabled uses #F3F4F6 and #9AA1AD; read-only takes the page fill (#FFFFFF) and stays legible.

sections.Motion & micro-interactions: No required entry/exit animation or timer; application may use the shared 200 ms overlay transition, with reduced-motion support and immediate state updates.

sections.Content rules: State the actual outcome: Agent saved or Upload failed. Include one useful corrective action; do not echo sensitive content or advertise a success before the operation resolves.

name: DropdownMenu

Highlighted rows use the track (#F1F3F6, #E8ECF2 on the grey panel); destructive rows are #D92644 with #FFD3DA highlight; disabled #9AA1AD.
sections.Icon behavior: Optional one EASM glyph per item, size 16 and currentColor. Glyphs cannot shrink. When any row has an icon, iconless rows retain a decorative 16 px spacer so every label shares the same text column.
sections.Typography: 14 px/500 command labels; wrap at sensible widths rather than shrinking. Use verbs describing the command outcome.
sections.Spacing: Menu inset 6 px; row inset 8 px vertical/10 px horizontal; icon/text gap 10 px. Trigger offset 6 px and viewport collision inset 12 px. Text columns stay aligned for mixed icon/no-icon rows.
sections.Borders & surfaces: 8 px menu radius (radius-float, the same corner as the trigger) with 4 px row corners concentric with the 4 px inset, no outline and no shadow; separation is by fill. At least 196 px wide and never narrower than the trigger. Scoped portal layers keep anchored children above their own surface and below deeper modals.
sections.Motion & micro-interactions: 200 ms anchored-overlay fade/small translation; reduced motion removes it. Item execution starts immediately; closing never delays the selected command.
sections.Accessibility: Radix menu semantics, trigger expanded/haspopup, roving focus, arrows/Home/End, typeahead and Escape with focus return. Item IDs/labels must be unique/nonempty. Trigger must accept ref and event props. Keyboard focus is one 2 px #2F6BEB edge with a soft 4 px halo (rgb(47 107 235 / 20%)): the focus-ring token. Fields show the halo around their own border (field-focus-ring); clipped rounded shells and menu rows use an inset 2 px edge. Forced colors keep a visible system outline. Destructive rows retain a danger-colored keyboard outline; forced colors uses system highlights.
sections.Responsive behavior: Collision-aware portal and available-height scrolling; labels wrap; rows 44 px for coarse pointers or layouts 600 px wide and below. Do not render more commands than users can inspect comfortably.
sections.Content rules: Use distinct action labels, such as Edit agent or Archive agent. Explain dangerous consequences in ConfirmationDialog when needed; disabled commands should have an accessible contextual explanation nearby.

sections.Accessibility: Radix supplies the modal focus trap, background interaction isolation, accessible title/description, Escape dismissal and trigger focus return. Provide restoreFocusRef for externally controlled launchers without a built-in trigger. Do not manually add competing roles or a second trap. name: ConfirmationDialog

sections.Purpose: Ask for an explicit decision before a consequential action, with clear consequences and safe cancellation.
sections.Anatomy: AlertDialog modal foundation; title, optional explanation/details; optional destructive symbol; cancel and confirm Buttons. Business callback owns the action and final closure.
sections.Variants: destructive=false default gives a normal primary confirm; destructive=true gives danger confirm and relevant warning symbol. loading reflects actual pending confirmation.
sections.Sizes: Compact dialog preset constrained by viewport. Standard action targets 40 px (44 coarse); enough width for explicit verb labels; body grows/scrolls if consequences need detail.
sections.States: Closed/open, safe cancel focus, confirmation pending, error/outcome managed by application. loading blocks duplicate confirmation and dismissal/cancel until the operation resolves; confirm never automatically closes on invocation.
sections.Color behavior: White panel; the warning tile is #D92644 on #FFF5F6. Confirm is destructive red only for a destructive action, otherwise the primary blue fill. Cancel stays the secondary grey fill.
sections.Icon behavior: Destructive warning indicator only when appropriate; confirm/cancel text carries meaning. No success icon before the operation finishes.

sections.Color behavior: Removable chips sit on #F6F7F9 with #101318 name and #5E6470 description; avatar and presence use their own tokens. Inside table cells a non-removable chip is plain (no fill). Disabled removes action emphasis without hiding the person.
sections.Icon behavior: Avatar supplies identity; close in the independent remove target. No generic user icon repeated beside a recognizable avatar.
sections.Typography: Name sm 13px/16px line-height or md 14px/20px line-height,600 weight; description 12px/16px line-height. Full name wraps; do not collapse to initials when that loses identity.
sections.Spacing: 4px border-inclusive avatar inset (3px padding plus 1px border),8px avatar/text gap; removable end inset also 4px, display-only copy end inset 8px. Long copy grows naturally without shrinking the avatar.
sections.Borders & surfaces: No outline. The 12 px frame minus a 4 px inset equals the 8 px avatar radius; the image mask follows the avatar edge and the remove target stays independent.
sections.Motion & micro-interactions: No automatic animation. Removal follows application state immediately; focus moves to the next sensible selectable person/trigger.
sections.Accessibility: Visible name provides identity; inner Avatar is decorative to avoid duplicates, status has hidden explanatory text. Remove control announces Remove plus the user name. No nested buttons. Keyboard focus is one 2 px #2F6BEB edge with a soft 4 px halo (rgb(47 107 235 / 20%)): the focus-ring token. Fields show the halo around their own border (field-focus-ring); clipped rounded shells and menu rows use an inset 2 px edge. Forced colors keep a visible system outline.
sections.Responsive behavior: Wrap identity/description and chip groups; preserve removal 44 px on coarse pointers. Do not make the full chip an ambiguous click target.
sections.Content rules: Use real display name and a concise distinguishing description, such as Admissions support. Status is descriptive; removal label identifies the exact person.
sections.Usage rules: Use for selected/assigned people. Use Avatar for purely visual identity and Chip for generic filter values. Application owns assignment/removal and resulting focus.

api: UserChipProps: span attributes; name required; description?,src?,status?; size=sm|md; onRemove?; disabled?.

name: ModuleIcon

sections.Purpose: Give a product module a recognizable, restrained graphic tile in navigation or an overview.
sections.Anatomy: Noninteractive rounded tile containing one EASM icon; optional label determines whether it is meaningful or decorative.
sections.Variants: tone=brand(default), neutral or signature. Signature is a restrained EASM brand accent, not routine status or action emphasis.
sections.Sizes: Tile 32/40/48 px for sm/md/lg; glyph 20/24/32 px centered. Noninteractive tile is visual size; surrounding navigation control owns a 44 px coarse target.
sections.States: Static tile; no automatic hover, pressed, selection or loading. Parent navigation handles state without changing the module glyph arbitrarily.
sections.Color behavior: Brand tile #EEF4FF with a #2563EB glyph; neutral #F6F7F9 with #101318; signature #FFF0E5 with #101318 and a restrained #FF6A00 core. For easm-one, signature sets --easm-icon-core:var(--easm-ui-signature), keeping dark rails and an orange core. Never put small white text on orange.
sections.Icon behavior: One approved IconName with clean 1.6 px geometry and consistent optical center. Use easm-one for the EASM One platform identity; its 6x 6 core stays solid in all eight treatments, including outline, and the rail-to-core gaps are intentional. Other modules keep stable functional metaphors. The separate 64-unit marketing brandmark is not a product glyph; avoid combining unrelated glyphs into a logo.
sections.Typography: No visible text inside the tile. Nearby module label uses product typography; optional accessible label names the module.
sections.Spacing: Centered glyph with consistent breathing room. Keep 8–12 px between tile and visible module title.
sections.Borders & surfaces: Corner radius 8/10/12 px by size; a flat tinted fill without outline or shadow. Larger artwork stays fully inside its tile.
sections.Motion & micro-interactions: Static by default. Do not attach decorative continuous AI/pulse motion to module navigation; active process motion uses explicit feedback components.
sections.Accessibility: With label it is a named graphic; without label it is decorative, appropriate beside visible module text. Tile is not a button and has no tabindex.
sections.Responsive behavior: Keep tile size from the defined presets. Parent layout can hide decorative tile when necessary, preserving the visible navigation label.
sections.Content rules: Use the stable module name, such as Knowledge management, when standalone. Parent navigation still needs its own meaningful name.
sections.Usage rules: Use to support module recognition, sparingly. For EASM One use ModuleIcon icon="easm-one" tone="signature"; omit label beside an existing visible name. Use IconButton for commands and StatusBadge for operational states; do not use signature tone as a selected-state workaround or identity as a generic loader.

api: ModuleIconProps: span attributes; icon:IconName required; label?:string; size=sm|md|lg; tone=brand|neutral|signature.

name: CopyControl

sections.Purpose: Copy an explicit text value to the clipboard with truthful busy, success and failure feedback.
sections.Anatomy: Button or IconButton, state-driven copy/check icon, named action, polite live message and visible manual-copy failure guidance.
sections.Variants: iconOnly=false(default) shows label; iconOnly=true retains required accessible action naming. size follows control scale. No automatic clipboard-read or unrelated export behavior.
sections.Sizes: sm: 32 px; md: 40 px (default); lg: 48 px. These are minimum heights, so translated or wrapped text may increase height. Coarse pointers receive a minimum 44 px target. iconOnly uses a square target; feedback wraps beside/below it rather than increasing the glyph size.
sections.States: Idle, copying, copied, error and disabled. Repeat copy is blocked during pending write. Confirmed success changes the action label to Copied. Changing text resets feedback and stale completions must not mark a new value copied.
sections.Color behavior: Secondary grey fill action with a #101318 icon and label. Completed feedback is truthful; error guidance uses #D92644. Failure never shows a checkmark.
sections.Icon behavior: copy at idle/error; check only after clipboard write resolves. Busy state follows Button; icons inherit the action foreground.
sections.Typography: Button 13/14/16 px; error message 13 px readable prose. State feedback must not turn into internal exception text.
sections.Spacing: 8 px between control and feedback; wrap on narrow containers; reserve space to avoid moving neighboring task actions.
sections.Borders & surfaces: Button and IconButton 8 px radius, no outline and no extra container. Keep the focus halo visible while an async write is pending.
sections.Motion & micro-interactions: Color, border and opacity transitions use 140 ms with cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1). Reduced motion removes transitions. Interaction and application work start immediately; animation never delays an operation. No delayed success pulse or forced reset timer; success represents the actual completed write.
sections.Accessibility: Named native control; pending uses focus-preserving busy state. Polite live text announces copied/failure without moving focus. Visible failure tells user to select/copy text manually. Keyboard focus is one 2 px #2F6BEB edge with a soft 4 px halo (rgb(47 107 235 / 20%)): the focus-ring token. Fields show the halo around their own border (field-focus-ring); clipped rounded shells and menu rows use an inset 2 px edge. Forced colors keep a visible system outline.
sections.Responsive behavior: Hidden decorative grid measures reserve the wider of the original label and Copied, preventing target width changes. Feedback wraps beneath target; iconOnly target remains 44 px coarse. The original text should remain accessible for manual copy if the browser denies clipboard access.
sections.Content rules: label names the value: Copy conversation ID. onCopy callback runs only after the browser confirms write success. Failure copy should provide a practical alternative.
sections.Usage rules: Supply the exact text to copy, not formatted HTML. Application owns exposing sensitive values and manual fallback. Test clipboard access in the actual secure-context/browser environment.

api: CopyControlProps: text:string required; label defaultCopy; size; iconOnly defaultfalse; disabled; onCopy?(text:string); className.
example: <CopyControl text="CONV-1042" label="Copy conversation ID" />

name: OverflowMenu

sections.Purpose: Collect secondary object actions under a familiar, explicitly named overflow trigger.
sections.Anatomy: IconButton more-horizontal trigger and DropdownMenu items; wrapper adds no separate business semantics.
sections.Variants: Flat MenuItem command list, optional disabled trigger; size=sm|md|lg. It does not add submenu, selection or navigation abstractions.
sections.Sizes: Trigger square 32/40/48 px, coarse 44 px minimum; menu rows 40 desktop/44 coarse. Content width follows DropdownMenu.
sections.States: Trigger hover/focus/disabled, menu closed/open, item highlighted/disabled/destructive. Business handlers own pending/outcomes.
sections.Color behavior: Subtle trigger with a #2563EB glyph and #EEF4FF hover; the menu follows DropdownMenu (surface by context, destructive rows in red). No orange emphasis.
sections.Icon behavior: Fixed more-horizontal trigger (the approved shared @easm-ui/icons registry glyph); optional EASM item icons. Trigger label communicates scope because the three dots alone cannot name the object.
sections.Typography: No visible trigger label; menu commands 14 px/500. Accessible label is concise, object-specific text.
sections.Spacing: Standalone compact target with 8 px separation from other actions; menu inset and row spacing use DropdownMenu recipes.
sections.Borders & surfaces: 8 px trigger radius and an 8 px menu (radius-float) without outline or shadow; keep portal and focus edges unclipped.
sections.Motion & micro-interactions: 140 ms trigger colors,200 ms menu entry/exit; reduced motion removes both. Command starts immediately.
sections.Accessibility: Default label More actions can be replaced with More actions for Admissions agent. IconButton naming and Radix menu keyboard/focus return behavior apply. Keyboard focus is one 2 px #2F6BEB edge with a soft 4 px halo (rgb(47 107 235 / 20%)): the focus-ring token. Fields show the halo around their own border (field-focus-ring); clipped rounded shells and menu rows use an inset 2 px edge. Forced colors keep a visible system outline.
sections.Responsive behavior: 44 px trigger/menu targets on coarse pointers; collision-aware popup keeps commands visible. Do not hide the one principal action solely to save space.
sections.Content rules: Only secondary related commands. Use explicit item verbs and keep destructive actions clearly named and confirmed when needed.
sections.Usage rules: Use on repeated rows/cards where object context is clear. Keep the primary action visible. Supply stable unique MenuItem IDs and permission-aware disabled states.

api: OverflowMenuProps: items:MenuItem[] required; label defaults More actions; size=sm|md|lg; disabled; className.
example: <OverflowMenu label="More actions for Admissions agent" items={[{ id: "edit", label: "Edit agent", onSelect: () => editAgent() }, { id: "archive", label: "Archive agent", destructive: true, onSelect: () => reviewArchive() }]} />
